messages:
alex: heads up — customer AcmeAnalytics reporting intermittent 429s during overnight ingest window (~02:00-03:00 UTC). They're on the free plan but say their throughput is modest. Can we confirm if this is quota exhaustion, token rate-limited, or an auth glitch? Attaching sample response they pasted below.

quota-bot: Automated: support ticket #9872 created and queued for triage.

maya: @alex can you paste the exact error payload + x-request-id? Need org id & plan tier to start. Also: how many parallel workers are they running?

alex: here's the minimal repro they gave (redacted keys):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"open-l10n-2.7b","input":"batch payload..."}'
```
Response (truncated):
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-request-id: req_abc123
x-rate-limit-reset: 35
Retry-After: 30
```
Org: org_acme_001 (free)
Concurrent workers: 6
Peak batch size: ~2k tokens per request
Last spike observed: 2024-05-15T02:12:00Z

sophie: this looks like per-minute bucket exhaustion rather than a token validation error. x-rate-limit-reset + Retry-After are classic rate-limit headers. Free tier has small burst allowance; sustained parallel workers easily hit it. Do we know their token consumption in that minute? Also any retries without jitter will amplify the problem.

alex: customer says they backoff on 429 then retry immediately; they have a single cron pushing many workers. I'll pull token-usage windows and paste.

maya: quick mitigation options: 1) temporary time-limited burst uplift (12 hours) for the account, 2) advise customer to add exponential jitter and reduce concurrency, 3) sales-assisted short trial to evaluate paid plan. Which do we prefer?

james (sales): I can approve a short demo uplift. Send org id + billing contact. I can enable a 1-day trial boost (+5x burst) and send TOS. Note: for long-term ingest at this concurrency, recommend paid or Dedicated.

alex: org id org_acme_001, billing contact billing@acme.co. Customer agreed to trial uplift.

sophie: engineering notes for follow-up: - consider exposing \"adaptive-burst\" opt-in per route so we can safely raise per-minute windows for demo users; - implement jittered retry guidance in docs; - for platform: lower default concurrency for free plan or require queueing to avoid thundering-herd. I'll open an eng ticket for the config change.

maya: created SUP-9872, attached logs and repro curl, scheduled 12-hour uplift. @james (sales) please confirm when uplift applied so we can tell the customer to retry.

james (sales): uplift applied at 2024-05-15T03:10:00Z. Sent acceptance link & short invoice for conversion path. Will follow up in 24h to check metrics.

alex: customer confirmed fewer 429s post-uplift and will monitor. They'll try to reduce parallelism too. Closing current triage but leaving ticket open for conversion tracking. Thanks! :thumbsup:
